name: Grade 6 T2 Practice: June Week 3 - Debugging Paths
description: Practice words for testing, debugging, and improving robot paths.

words.definition: To try something and see if it works.
words.example: We test the program before showing it.

words.definition: To find and fix a problem in a program.
words.example: We debug when the robot turns the wrong way.
We improve the route after testing.

words.definition: The way something moves from start to finish.
words.example: The mBot followed a tape path.

words.definition: The path used to get from one place to another.
Something that is not working or needs to be solved.
words.example: The problem was a missing stop command.
We changed the time to fix the movement.
